title: Armv8-M Architecture Reference Manual
semantics: FZ transforms single/double subnormal inputs to signed zero and raises Input Denormal; IDC is its status flag.
Scalar VCMP uses FPSCR-controlled comparison and quiet_nan_exc false; FPCompare raises invalid for signaling NaN and returns unordered NZCV for any NaN.
Official M55 manual101051/0101 revision0101-03 confirms FZ/DefaultNaN support and FPSCR reset0x40000 (LTPSIZE default, not FZ16).
